summary: Support optional IPv6 ingress alongside existing IPv4 HTTP and HTTPS listeners
details: Add bind_address_ipv6 for bundled ingress, configure --bind-address-ipv6/--no-ipv6 and interactive setup; preserve IPv4 defaults and require loopback for private IPv6 exposure.
Publish only the proxy on the additional IPv6 address, enable native IPv6 on its app network, and generate HTTP/HTTPS listeners and redirects; private services gain no published ports.

Report IPv6 loopback and default-route host checks separately, preserving Host, SNI, certificate validation and failure exit codes; skipped host discovery does not establish external IPv6 reachability.
External proxies retain ownership of IPv6 listeners. IPv6 is opt-in and requires host/Docker IPv6 support, suitable DNS and independently managed router/host firewall rules.
operator_actions: Install the new release; enable IPv6 in setup or, for an existing public local-node deployment, run configure --local-node --bind-address-ipv6 ::.
Apply changed networking with down, prepare --replace, preflight and up; retain volumes. Run check and verify IPv4 and IPv6 separately from an external client.
Configure the domain AAAA record and IPv6 firewall reachability. To revert the additional listener, use configure --local-node --no-ipv6 and repeat the deployment replacement.
